name: MyDCD Berhad
summary: MyDCD Berhad specializes in the integration and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection (MEPF) systems, and related products and services for data centers in Malaysia. The company provides integration of MEPF systems where it manages the entire process, including engineering support, supply and installation, as well as testing and commissioning. The company's mechanical system in a data centre focuses on thermal management through cooling systems, such as ACMV systems including containment systems and heat rejection systems.
